G1_material.provenance: SantaLucia J Jr 1998, PNAS 95:1460-1465, 'A unified view of polymer, dumbbell, and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics'. Unified NN Delta-G_37 set; the same pipeline the corpus uses for measured gamma.

G2_regulatory.provenance: Core cardiac TF code: GATA4, NKX2-5, MEF2C, TBX5, and bHLH/HAND. Consensus motifs from JASPAR (GATA4 MA0482; NKX2-5 MA0063; MEF2C MA0497; TBX5 MA0807; bHLH E-box) and the cardiac-GRN literature (Olson 2006, Science 313:1922; Bruneau 2013, CSH Perspect Biol 5:a008292; Akazawa & Komuro 2003). The combinatorial arrangement of these sites is the established cis-regulatory grammar of cardiac enhancers.

shuffle.provenance: Altschul SF & Erickson BW 1985, Mol Biol Evol 2:526-538, 'Significance of nucleotide sequence alignments: a method for random sequence permutation that preserves dinucleotide and codon usage'.
